context: A café between the office and home. Yuki and Mei have been close since university; haven't seen each other in three months.
purpose: long-time friend catch-up — old shorthand, real warmth

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ゆきー！久しぶり、本当に！
lines.style: Bright upward lift on the opening. Genuine warmth radiating through. Quick pace, not performed—the joy of recognition landing immediately. Small exhale of relief at seeing her.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: メイ、元気そう。…私、なんか緊張する。
lines.en: Mei—you look really good. …I'm feeling weirdly nervous.
lines.style: Slight self-conscious laugh at herself, questioning why the nervousness is even there. Sits down. Soft vulnerability underneath—voice carries the small weight of the moment without dragging it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: なんでよ。私たち、何年の友達やと思ってんの。
lines.en: Why would you be nervous? How many years have we been friends now?
lines.style: Gentle affectionate prod—not dismissing the nerves but gently reminding. Warm steady voice. The question lands like a small reassurance wrapped in logic.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 十二年、たぶん。…(small laugh)時間って、すごい。
lines.en: Twelve years, I think. …(small laugh) Time really is something.
lines.style: Genuine small laugh—not performed. Voice softens on the realization. Slight pause before the last phrase, letting the weight of years settle. Warm and slightly in awe.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Really. …So what's been going on with you lately?
lines.style: Leans forward slightly. Full present attention—curiosity without pressure. Steady warm voice. The question carries real listening underneath it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 色々ある。仕事…結構、本気で考えてて。
lines.en: Quite a bit, actually. Work—I've been thinking about it seriously.
lines.style: Steady, honest line. Voice slightly grounded, like stepping onto solid ground to say it out loud. No rehearsal—the words arriving as she speaks them.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そっか。…一緒に、考えよっか、今日。
lines.en: I see. …Let's work through it together today.
lines.style: Generous, unhesitating offer. The word 「一緒に」 lands with quiet commitment. Warmth without performance. Safe space in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Small voice catching slightly, emotion threading through without overtaking. Genuine gratitude—unforced, sincere. The whole quiet moment lands here.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん。…時間あるよ、たくさん。
lines.en: Mm. …I've got plenty of time for you.
lines.style: Full-hearted, unhurried commitment. Quiet and absolute. Both lean in. The voice carries weight—not rushed, not heavy, just completely present.
